+# Mixing from an Expanding Minimal Real Flow
+
+## Abstract
+
+Expanding covariance of a compact minimal real flow forces topological mixing of the expanding map.
+
+**Theorem 1.1 (Every sufficiently large iterate meets each pair of nonempty open sets).**
+
+$$\forall X \in Type,\; \forall alpha \in \operatorname{RealAction}\left(X\right),\; \forall a \in R,\; \forall f \in \operatorname{SelfMap}\left(X\right),\; \left(\operatorname{CompactHausdorff}\left(X\right) \land \left(\operatorname{JointlyContinuous}\left(alpha\right) \land \left(\operatorname{Minimal}\left(alpha\right) \land \left(1 < a \land \left(\operatorname{Continuous}\left(f\right) \land \left(\forall t \in R,\; \forall x \in X,\; \operatorname{f}\left(\operatorname{alpha}\left(t, x\right)\right) = \operatorname{alpha}\left(a \cdot t, \operatorname{f}\left(x\right)\right)\right)\right)\right)\right)\right)\right) \Rightarrow \left(\forall U \in \operatorname{Set}\left(X\right),\; \forall V \in \operatorname{Set}\left(X\right),\; \left(\operatorname{IsOpen}\left(U\right) \land \left(\operatorname{Nonempty}\left(U\right) \land \left(\operatorname{IsOpen}\left(V\right) \land \operatorname{Nonempty}\left(V\right)\right)\right)\right) \Rightarrow \left(\exists N \in Nat,\; \forall n \in Nat,\; N \le n \Rightarrow \left(\exists x \in X,\; x \in U \land \operatorname{iterate}\left(f, n, x\right) \in V\right)\right)\right)$$
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S1/Dynamics/MinimalFlowDilationMixing.minimal_real_flow_dilation_mixing` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+Let X be a compact Hausdorff topological space with an additive action alpha of the real numbers. The action is jointly continuous and minimal: the orbit of every point is dense in X. Let a be a real number greater than one and f a continuous map from X to itself satisfying f(alpha(t,x)) = alpha(a*t,f(x)) for all real t and all x in X. For every pair U,V of nonempty open subsets of X there is a natural N such that, for every natural n at least N, some x in U has f iterated n times at x in V. The witness x may depend on n. No global nonemptiness of X is assumed; the open-set assertion is vacuous on the empty space.
+
+Choose u in U. Continuity of the orbit map at time zero gives a positive epsilon such that alpha(s,u) belongs to U whenever the absolute value of s is less than epsilon. Minimality makes translates of V cover X. Compactness and Mathlib's IsCompact.exists_finite_cover_vadd give a finite set I of translating times. If z = alpha(s,v) for s in I and v in V, then alpha(-s,z) = v. Thus the sum M of the absolute values of times in I bounds a hitting time for every z in X. The minus sign converts a covering translate into a hitting time.
+
+Induction gives f^n(alpha(s,u)) = alpha(a^n*s,f^n(u)). Since a is greater than one, Mathlib's tendsto_pow_atTop_atTop_of_one_lt makes M/a^n less than epsilon for every sufficiently large n. For each such n choose a bounded hitting time t for f^n(u). The point alpha(t/a^n,u) lies in U and its nth iterate is alpha(t,f^n(u)), which lies in V. The uniform bound over all z is what gives every sufficiently large n.
+
+For the actual dyadic inverse limit DyadicSolenoid of DyadicTimeSeparation, take alpha(t,x) = realFlow(t) + x, a = 2 and f(x) = 2 times x in the additive group. The public dyadic_time_separation theorem supplies compactness and the continuous dense-range realFlow, whose nth circle coordinate is t/2^n modulo one. The inherited product topology is Hausdorff. Translation by x is a homeomorphism, so composing it with the dense-range realFlow makes every orbit dense. The homomorphism law makes alpha an additive real action; its continuity is joint. Doubling is continuous and realFlow(2*t) = 2 times realFlow(t), giving the exact expanding covariance. Consequently doubling on this dyadic solenoid is topologically mixing in the displayed all-sufficiently-large-n sense. This exact application is checked with a local action instance, without changing the solenoid's public action instances or retaining a named specialization.
+
+The conclusion concerns topological mixing of the discrete map f. It assumes no group structure on X, freeness of the real action, surjectivity or invertibility of f. It makes no entropy, periodic-point or chaos assertion and does not assert that the real flow is mixing. The compact Hausdorff and continuity-of-f hypotheses are retained in the declared theorem; the argument uses compactness, minimality, action continuity and expanding covariance. The searched pinned Dynamics minimality and transitivity APIs do not supply this all-large-iterate implication. This is a repository proof of the displayed inference, with no claim of novelty in the literature.
+
+## References
+
+- Truth anchor: `D5/S1/Dynamics/MinimalFlowDilationMixing.minimal_real_flow_dilation_mixing`

+# Critical Theta Tail Peaks
+
+## Abstract
+
+Critical-exponent positive peaks of the signed activation-weighted theta tail.
+
+**Theorem 1.1 (An explicit amplitude for every genuine zero).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Weil/Mertens/CriticalThetaTailPeak.critical_theta_tail_peak`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/Weil/Mertens/CriticalThetaTailPeak.critical_theta_tail_peak` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+Let rho be a genuine zero of Riemann zeta with one half < Re(rho) < one. Write beta=Re(rho), sigma=beta-1 and m for its analytic multiplicity. The multiplicity is positive and Im(rho) is nonzero. For every real c with 0 <= c < m/(norm(rho) norm(rho-1)) and every real T, there is u > max(T,log 2) such that c < u exp((1-beta)u) f(u). Here f is the actual signed tail from ActualThetaTailLaplace, using the reciprocal logarithmic activation density; it equals the original tail F(exp u) at every real u.
+
+Suppose instead that the indicated normalized tail is eventually at most c. At one positive cutoff U, put h(u)=c exp(sigma u)/u and g=h-f on u>U. Actual integrability of f and exponential decay of h make g an integrable nonnegative density, hence a finite positive measure. Its actual Laplace transform G is a complex moment-generating function. Its comparison transform K is the actual transform of h. Genuine differentiation gives K'(z)=-c exp(-(z-sigma)U)/(z-sigma) and K''(z)=c exp(-(z-sigma)U)(1/(z-sigma)^2+U/(z-sigma)). For c>0, K itself has a logarithmic boundary singularity; for c=0, K=0. In neither case is a meromorphic extension of K across sigma presumed.
+
+The actual signed theta transform L satisfies the Euler equation zL''+2L'=T+B on the positive half-plane, where T=-M'+M and B=U^2 f(U) exp(-zU). Consequently G=K-L has meromorphic Euler forcing P-T-B, where P is the explicit Euler image of K. This forcing is regular at every real point strictly to the right of sigma. PositiveEulerContinuation therefore gives actual exponential integrability throughout Re(z)>sigma. Subtracting the weighted integrable densities h and g gives weighted absolute integrability of the actual signed tail there, and L=K-G is holomorphic on that half-plane.
+
+The normalized-zeta formula and the positive-real sign of zeta make T+B holomorphic at the real point sigma. EulerLocalContinuation extends the signed solution L across sigma on a full complex disk. Its first two derivatives are consequently bounded along sigma+epsilon as epsilon decreases to zero. The explicit derivatives of K then give epsilon^2 times the first positive moment tending to zero and epsilon^2 times the second positive moment tending to c. No boundary convergence of the signed integral or of positive moments is presumed.
+
+At the nonreal point a=rho-1 the exact double-pole coefficient of T is -m/rho. P and B are regular there. A punctured neighborhood of that selected pole, together with the Euler identity at its regular points, gives epsilon^2 (zG''+2G')(a+epsilon) tending to m/rho. Positivity of the genuine moment integrals gives norm(G'(x+i gamma)) <= -G'(x) and norm(G''(x+i gamma)) <= G''(x). Their real limits imply m/norm(rho) <= norm(rho-1)c, contradicting the assumed strict coefficient bound. No rightmost-zero hypothesis is needed.
+
+Taking c to be half the positive amplitude supplies conditional arbitrarily late peaks. Since exp((beta-one half)u)/u tends to infinity, these eventually cross an envelope of the form 7 exp(-u/2). An arithmetic bridge from that envelope to actual prefix least-common-multiple Robin violations is a separate requirement. This theorem does not assert an off-line zero, the Riemann hypothesis, an unconditional violating integer, an effective peak location, an endpoint beta=one half or beta=one, or a peak strictly above the limiting amplitude. The argument uses classical positive Laplace continuation and local pole comparison; no literature originality is asserted.
+

+/-- A continuous map expanding a compact minimal real flow is topologically mixing:
+every sufficiently large iterate sends some point of each nonempty open set into
+each other nonempty open set. No nonemptiness assumption on the space is needed. -/
+theorem minimal_real_flow_dilation_mixing
+    {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X]
+    [AddAction ℝ X] [ContinuousVAdd ℝ X] [AddAction.IsMinimal ℝ X]
+    (a : ℝ) (ha : 1 < a) (f : X → X) (_hfcont : Continuous f)
+    (hf : ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : X), f (t +ᵥ x) = (a * t) +ᵥ f x) :
+    ∀ U V : Set X, IsOpen U → U.Nonempty → IsOpen V → V.Nonempty →
+      ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, ∃ x, x ∈ U ∧ (f^[n]) x ∈ V := by
+  classical
+  intro U V hU hUne hV hVne
+  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hUne
+  have hpre : IsOpen ((fun s : ℝ => s +ᵥ u) ⁻¹' U) :=
+    hU.preimage (continuous_id.vadd continuous_const)

+  obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ := isCompact_univ.exists_finite_cover_vadd (G := ℝ) hV hVne

+      congr 1
+      rw [pow_succ]
+      ring

+    ((tendsto_pow_atTop_atTop_of_one_lt ha).eventually

+      (mul_nonneg hc (Real.exp_pos _).le) hu0.le), real_smul,
+      Complex.ofReal_div, Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_exp]
+    have hun : (u : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hu0.ne'
+    rw [show -(z - (σ : ℂ)) * (u : ℂ) =
+      (σ : ℂ) * (u : ℂ) + -z * (u : ℂ) by ring, Complex.exp_add]
+    push_cast
+    field_simp
+  rw [integral_congr_ae he, integral_const_mul,
+    integral_exp_mul_complex_Ioi (by simp only [neg_re, sub_re, ofReal_re]; linarith)]
+  simp only [div_neg]
+  ring
+
+private theorem envelope_first {U σ c : ℝ}
+    (hU : 0 < U) (hσ : σ < 0) (hc : 0 ≤ c) {z : ℂ} (hz : σ < z.re) :
+    deriv (laplace (density U (envelope σ c))) z =
+      -(c : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-(z - (σ : ℂ)) * (U : ℂ)) / (z - (σ : ℂ)) := by
+  rw [laplace_deriv (envelope_exp_integrable hU hσ hc) hz,
+    envelope_moment_one hU hσ hc hz]
+  ring
+
+private theorem envelope_analytic {U σ c : ℝ}
+    (hU : 0 < U) (hσ : σ < 0) (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
+    AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (laplace (density U (envelope σ c))) {z | σ < z.re} := by
+  have hd : DifferentiableOn ℂ (laplace (density U (envelope σ c))) {z | σ < z.re} := by
+    intro z hz
+    have hh := (moment_hasDeriv (envelope_exp_integrable hU hσ hc) 0 hz).differentiableAt
+    have he : moment (density U (envelope σ c)) 0 = laplace (density U (envelope σ c)) := by
+      ext w
+      simp [moment, laplace, complexMGF]
+    rw [he] at hh
+    exact hh.differentiableWithinAt
+  exact hd.analyticOnNhd (isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re)
+
+private theorem envelope_second {U σ c : ℝ}
+    (hU : 0 < U) (hσ : σ < 0) (hc : 0 ≤ c) {z : ℂ} (hz : σ < z.re) :
+    deriv (deriv (laplace (density U (envelope σ c)))) z =
+      (c : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-(z - (σ : ℂ)) * (U : ℂ)) *
+        (1 / (z - (σ : ℂ)) ^ 2 + (U : ℂ) / (z - (σ : ℂ))) := by
+  have he : deriv (laplace (density U (envelope σ c))) =ᶠ[𝓝 z]
+      fun w => -(c : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-(w - (σ : ℂ)) * (U : ℂ)) / (w - (σ : ℂ)) := by
+    filter_upwards [(isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).mem_nhds hz]
+      with w hw using envelope_first hU hσ hc hw
+  have hn : z - (σ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
+    intro heq
+    have hr := congrArg Complex.re (sub_eq_zero.mp heq)
+    simp only [ofReal_re] at hr
+    linarith
+  rw [he.deriv_eq]
+  have hd := ((((hasDerivAt_id z).sub_const (σ : ℂ)).neg.mul_const (U : ℂ)).cexp.const_mul
+    (-(c : ℂ))).div ((hasDerivAt_id z).sub_const (σ : ℂ)) hn
+  change HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ =>
+    -(c : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-(w - (σ : ℂ)) * (U : ℂ)) / (w - (σ : ℂ))) _ z at hd
+  rw [hd.deriv]
+  dsimp only [id_eq, Pi.neg_apply]
+  field_simp
+  ring
+
+private def euler (F : ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ := z * deriv (deriv F) z + 2 * deriv F z
+
+private theorem euler_congr {F G : ℂ → ℂ} {z : ℂ} (he : F =ᶠ[𝓝 z] G) :
+    euler F z = euler G z := by
+  simp only [euler, he.deriv_eq, he.deriv.deriv_eq]
+
+private theorem euler_sub {F G : ℂ → ℂ} {z : ℂ}
+    (hF : AnalyticAt ℂ F z) (hG : AnalyticAt ℂ G z) :
+    euler (fun w => F w - G w) z = euler F z - euler G z := by
+  have he : deriv (fun w => F w - G w) =ᶠ[𝓝 z] fun w => deriv F w - deriv G w := by
+    filter_upwards [hF.eventually_analyticAt, hG.eventually_analyticAt] with w hf hg
+    exact deriv_sub hf.differentiableAt hg.differentiableAt
+  rw [euler, he.deriv_eq]
+  change z * deriv (deriv F - deriv G) z + 2 * deriv (F - G) z = _
+  rw [deriv_sub hF.deriv.differentiableAt hG.deriv.differentiableAt,
+    deriv_sub hF.differentiableAt hG.differentiableAt]
+  simp only [euler]
+  ring
+
+private def boundary (U : ℝ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
+  (U : ℂ) ^ 2 * (ActualThetaTailLaplace.f U : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-z * (U : ℂ))
+
+private def forcing (U : ℝ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
+  -deriv (ThetaLaplaceContinuation.M U) z + ThetaLaplaceContinuation.M U z + boundary U z
+
+private theorem forcing_meromorphic (U : ℝ) (hU : 0 ≤ U) :
+    MeromorphicOn (forcing U) ThetaLaplaceContinuation.D := by
+  have hm := (ThetaLaplaceContinuation.theta_laplace_continuation U hU).2.2.2.2.1
+  exact (hm.deriv.neg.add hm).add (by intro z hz; exact (by unfold boundary; fun_prop :
+    AnalyticAt ℂ (boundary U) z).meromorphicAt)
+
+private theorem normalized_zeta_real_ne_zero {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
+    riemannZeta₁ (x : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
+  by_cases hx1 : x = 1
+  · subst x
+    simp
+  · have hs := D5.S3.Analytic.Isolation.RiemannZetaPositiveRealSign.riemannZeta_ofReal_sign hx hx1
+    have hz : riemannZeta (x : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
+      intro hz
+      rw [hz] at hs
+      rcases hs.2 with h | h <;> simp only [zero_re] at h <;> linarith [h.2]
+    intro hn
+    apply hz
+    rw [riemannZeta_eq_inv_sub_mul (by exact_mod_cast hx1), hn, mul_zero]
+
+private theorem theta_M_real_analytic (U : ℝ) (hU : 0 ≤ U) {x : ℝ}
+    (hx : -(1 / 2 : ℝ) < x) : AnalyticAt ℂ (ThetaLaplaceContinuation.M U) (x : ℂ) := by
+  obtain ⟨hC, hA, _, _, _, hzero, _⟩ :=
+    ThetaLaplaceContinuation.theta_laplace_continuation U hU
+  by_cases hx0 : x = 0
+  · subst x
+    simpa using hzero
+  have hn := normalized_zeta_real_ne_zero (by linarith : 0 < 1 + x)
+  have hna : AnalyticAt ℂ (logDeriv riemannZeta₁) ((1 + x : ℝ) : ℂ) :=
+    (differentiable_riemannZeta₁.analyticAt _).deriv.div
+      (differentiable_riemannZeta₁.analyticAt _) hn
+  have hcomp : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun z => logDeriv riemannZeta₁ (1 + z)) (x : ℂ) := by
+    exact hna.comp_of_eq (by fun_prop : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun z : ℂ => 1 + z) (x : ℂ))
+      (by push_cast; ring)
+  have hc : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun z => ThetaLaplaceContinuation.C (1 + z)) (x : ℂ) :=
+    (hC (1 + (x : ℂ)) (by simp; linarith)).comp (by fun_prop)
+  unfold ThetaLaplaceContinuation.M
+  exact (((analyticAt_const.add hcomp).add hc).neg.div (by fun_prop)
+    (by intro h; have hr := congrArg Complex.re h; simp at hr; linarith)).sub (hA.analyticAt _)
+
+private theorem forcing_real_analytic (U : ℝ) (hU : 0 ≤ U) {x : ℝ}
+    (hx : -(1 / 2 : ℝ) < x) : AnalyticAt ℂ (forcing U) (x : ℂ) := by
+  have hm := theta_M_real_analytic U hU hx
+  exact (hm.deriv.neg.add hm).add (by unfold boundary; fun_prop)

+private theorem actual_euler (U : ℝ) (hU : ActualThetaTailLaplace.u₀ ≤ U)
+    {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.re) : euler (ActualThetaTailLaplace.L U) z = forcing U z := by
+  have hU0 : 0 ≤ U := (Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)).le.trans hU
+  have hcont := ThetaLaplaceContinuation.theta_laplace_continuation U hU0
+  have hqm : ThetaLaplaceContinuation.Q U =ᶠ[𝓝 z] ThetaLaplaceContinuation.M U := by
+    filter_upwards [(isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).mem_nhds hz] with w hw
+    exact (hcont.2.2.2.1 w hw).2.1
+  have he := ((ActualThetaTailLaplace.actual_theta_tail_laplace_ode).2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2 U hU).2 z hz
+  simpa only [euler, forcing, boundary, hqm.deriv_eq, hqm.eq_of_nhds] using he.2.2.2

+private def envelopeEuler (U σ c : ℝ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
+  (c : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-(z - (σ : ℂ)) * (U : ℂ)) *
+    (z / (z - (σ : ℂ)) ^ 2 + (z * (U : ℂ) - 2) / (z - (σ : ℂ)))
+
+private theorem envelope_euler {U σ c : ℝ}
+    (hU : 0 < U) (hσ : σ < 0) (hc : 0 ≤ c) {z : ℂ} (hz : σ < z.re) :
+    euler (laplace (density U (envelope σ c))) z = envelopeEuler U σ c z := by
+  rw [euler, envelope_first hU hσ hc hz, envelope_second hU hσ hc hz]
+  unfold envelopeEuler
+  ring
+
+private theorem envelopeEuler_analytic {U σ c : ℝ} {z : ℂ} (hz : z ≠ (σ : ℂ)) :
+    AnalyticAt ℂ (envelopeEuler U σ c) z := by
+  have hn : z - (σ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hz
+  unfold envelopeEuler
+  fun_prop (disch := simp [hn])
+
+private theorem zeta_zero_nonreal {ρ : ℂ} (hβ : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < ρ.re)
+    (hβ1 : ρ.re < 1) (hz : riemannZeta ρ = 0) : ρ.im ≠ 0 := by
+  intro him
+  have hr : (ρ.re : ℂ) = ρ := by apply Complex.ext <;> simp [him]
+  have hs := D5.S3.Analytic.Isolation.RiemannZetaPositiveRealSign.riemannZeta_ofReal_sign
+    (by linarith : 0 < ρ.re) hβ1.ne
+  rw [hr, hz] at hs
+  rcases hs.2 with h | h <;> simp only [zero_re] at h <;> linarith [h.1, h.2]

+private theorem complex_weight_integrable {U : ℝ} {w : ℝ → ℝ} {z : ℂ}
+    (hw : AEStronglyMeasurable w (volume.restrict (Ioi U)))
+    (hi : IntegrableOn (fun u => w u * Real.exp (-z.re * u)) (Ioi U)) :
+    IntegrableOn (fun u : ℝ => Complex.exp (-z * (u : ℂ)) * (w u : ℂ)) (Ioi U) := by
+  have hm : AEStronglyMeasurable
+      (fun u : ℝ => Complex.exp (-z * (u : ℂ)) * (w u : ℂ)) (volume.restrict (Ioi U)) := by
+    exact (by fun_prop : AEStronglyMeasurable
+      (fun u : ℝ => Complex.exp (-z * (u : ℂ))) (volume.restrict (Ioi U))).mul
+        (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hw)
+  apply (integrable_norm_iff hm).mp
+  convert hi.norm using 1
+  ext u
+  simp only [norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp, mul_re, neg_re, ofReal_re, neg_im, ofReal_im,
+    mul_zero, sub_zero, norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.abs_exp]
+  ring
+
+private def gap (σ c : ℝ) (u : ℝ) : ℝ := envelope σ c u - ActualThetaTailLaplace.f u
+
+private theorem actual_tail_integrable {U : ℝ} (hU : ActualThetaTailLaplace.u₀ ≤ U) :
+    IntegrableOn ActualThetaTailLaplace.f (Ioi U) :=
+  ActualThetaTailLaplace.actual_theta_tail_laplace_ode.2.2.2.2.1.mono_set (Ioi_subset_Ioi hU)
+
+private theorem gap_integrable {U σ c : ℝ} (hU : ActualThetaTailLaplace.u₀ ≤ U)
+    (hU0 : 0 < U) (hσ : σ < 0) (hc : 0 ≤ c) : IntegrableOn (gap σ c) (Ioi U) :=
+  (envelope_integrable hU0 hσ hc).sub (actual_tail_integrable hU)
+
+private theorem gap_nonneg {U σ c : ℝ}
+    (hbound : ∀ u : ℝ, U < u → ActualThetaTailLaplace.f u ≤ envelope σ c u) :
+    ∀ᵐ u ∂volume.restrict (Ioi U), 0 ≤ gap σ c u := by
+  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with u hu
+  exact sub_nonneg.mpr (hbound u hu)
+
+private theorem gap_laplace_eq {U σ c : ℝ} (hU : ActualThetaTailLaplace.u₀ ≤ U)
+    (hU0 : 0 < U) (hσ : σ < 0) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
+    (hbound : ∀ u : ℝ, U < u → ActualThetaTailLaplace.f u ≤ envelope σ c u)
+    {z : ℂ} (hz : σ < z.re)
+    (hfi : IntegrableOn (fun u => ActualThetaTailLaplace.f u * Real.exp (-z.re * u)) (Ioi U)) :
+    laplace (density U (gap σ c)) z =
+      laplace (density U (envelope σ c)) z - ActualThetaTailLaplace.L U z := by
+  rw [density_laplace (gap_integrable hU hU0 hσ hc) (gap_nonneg hbound),
+    density_laplace (envelope_integrable hU0 hσ hc) (envelope_nonneg hU0 hc),
+    ActualThetaTailLaplace.L]
+  simp only [gap, Complex.ofReal_sub, mul_sub]
+  exact integral_sub
+    (complex_weight_integrable (envelope_integrable hU0 hσ hc).aestronglyMeasurable
+      (envelope_weighted_integrable hU0 hc hz))
+    (complex_weight_integrable (actual_tail_integrable hU).aestronglyMeasurable hfi)
+
+private theorem comparison_halfplane {U σ c : ℝ}
+    (hU : ActualThetaTailLaplace.u₀ ≤ U) (hU0 : 0 < U)
+    (hσ : σ < 0) (hσhalf : -(1 / 2 : ℝ) < σ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
+    (hbound : ∀ u : ℝ, U < u → ActualThetaTailLaplace.f u ≤ envelope σ c u) :
+    (∀ x : ℝ, σ < x → Integrable (fun u => Real.exp (-x * u)) (density U (gap σ c))) ∧
+    (∀ x : ℝ, σ < x → IntegrableOn
+      (fun u => ActualThetaTailLaplace.f u * Real.exp (-x * u)) (Ioi U)) ∧
+    AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (ActualThetaTailLaplace.L U) {z | σ < z.re} ∧
+    (∀ z : ℂ, σ < z.re → AnalyticAt ℂ (forcing U) z →
+      euler (ActualThetaTailLaplace.L U) z = forcing U z) := by
+  let μ := density U (gap σ c)
+  let K := laplace (density U (envelope σ c))
+  let G := laplace μ
+  have hgi := gap_integrable hU hU0 hσ hc
+  have hgp := gap_nonneg hbound
+  haveI : IsFiniteMeasure μ := density_finite hgi hgp
+  have hpos := density_nonneg hU0.le (gap σ c)
+  have hK := envelope_analytic hU0 hσ hc
+  have hfi0 : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → IntegrableOn
+      (fun u => ActualThetaTailLaplace.f u * Real.exp (-x * u)) (Ioi U) := by
+    intro x hx
+    apply (actual_tail_integrable hU).norm.mono'
+    · exact (actual_tail_integrable hU).aestronglyMeasurable.mul (by fun_prop)
+    · filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with u hu
+      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, Real.abs_exp]
+      apply mul_le_of_le_one_right (abs_nonneg _)
+      exact Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (neg_nonpos.mpr hx.le)
+        (hU0.le.trans hu.le))
+  have hG0 : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.re → euler G z =
+      envelopeEuler U σ c z - forcing U z := by
+    intro z hz
+    have he : G =ᶠ[𝓝 z] fun w => K w - ActualThetaTailLaplace.L U w := by
+      filter_upwards [(isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).mem_nhds hz]
+        with w hw
+      exact gap_laplace_eq hU hU0 hσ hc hbound (lt_trans hσ hw) (hfi0 _ hw)
+    rw [euler_congr he, euler_sub (hK z (lt_trans hσ hz))
+      (((ActualThetaTailLaplace.actual_theta_tail_laplace_ode).2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2 U hU).1 z hz),
+      envelope_euler hU0 hσ hc (lt_trans hσ hz), actual_euler U hU hz]
+  have hP : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (envelopeEuler U σ c) {z | σ < z.re} := by
+    intro z hz
+    apply envelopeEuler_analytic
+    intro he
+    change σ < z.re at hz
+    exact (lt_irrefl σ) (by simpa only [he, ofReal_re] using hz)
+  have hRm : MeromorphicOn (fun z => envelopeEuler U σ c z - forcing U z)
+      {z | σ < z.re} := hP.meromorphicOn.sub
+    (fun z hz => forcing_meromorphic U hU0.le z (lt_trans hσhalf hz))
+  have hRa : ∀ x : ℝ, σ < x →
+      AnalyticAt ℂ (fun z => envelopeEuler U σ c z - forcing U z) (x : ℂ) := by
+    intro x hx
+    exact (hP x hx).sub (forcing_real_analytic U hU0.le (lt_trans hσhalf hx))
+  obtain ⟨hi, hG⟩ := D5.S3.Analytic.Laplace.PositiveEulerContinuation.integrable_and_analytic_of_euler
+    (μ := μ) (X := id) (by fun_prop) hpos hσ hRm hRa hG0
+  have hfi : ∀ x : ℝ, σ < x → IntegrableOn
+      (fun u => ActualThetaTailLaplace.f u * Real.exp (-x * u)) (Ioi U) := by
+    intro x hx
+    have hgx := (density_integrable hgi hgp _).mp (hi x hx)
+    convert (envelope_weighted_integrable hU0 hc hx).sub hgx using 1
+    ext u
+    dsimp only [gap, Pi.sub_apply, id_eq]
+    ring
+  have heq : ∀ z : ℂ, σ < z.re → ActualThetaTailLaplace.L U z = K z - G z := by
+    intro z hz
+    have he := gap_laplace_eq hU hU0 hσ hc hbound hz (hfi z.re hz)
+    change G z = K z - ActualThetaTailLaplace.L U z at he
+    linear_combination he
+  have hL : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (ActualThetaTailLaplace.L U) {z | σ < z.re} := by
+    intro z hz
+    apply ((hK z hz).sub (hG z hz)).congr
+    filter_upwards [(isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).mem_nhds hz]
+      with w hw using (heq w hw).symm
+  refine ⟨hi, hfi, hL, ?_⟩
+  let D : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => euler (ActualThetaTailLaplace.L U) z - forcing U z
+  have hDm : MeromorphicOn D {z | σ < z.re} := by
+    have hm := hL.meromorphicOn
+    exact ((analyticOnNhd_id.meromorphicOn.mul hm.deriv.deriv).add
+      (analyticOnNhd_const.meromorphicOn.mul hm.deriv)).sub
+      (fun z hz => forcing_meromorphic U hU0.le z (lt_trans hσhalf hz))
+  have hD1 : meromorphicOrderAt D (1 : ℂ) = ⊤ := by
+    apply meromorphicOrderAt_eq_top_iff.mpr
+    apply Filter.Eventually.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds
+    filter_upwards [(isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).mem_nhds
+      (show (0 : ℝ) < (1 : ℂ).re by norm_num)] with z hz
+    exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (actual_euler U hU hz)
+  intro z hz hRz
+  have htop := hDm.meromorphicOrderAt_eq_top_of_isPreconnected
+    (convex_halfSpace_re_gt σ).isPreconnected
+    (show σ < (1 : ℂ).re by simp only [one_re]; linarith) hz hD1
+  have hDc : ContinuousAt D z := by
+    exact ((continuousAt_id.mul (hL z hz).deriv.deriv.continuousAt).add
+      ((hL z hz).deriv.continuousAt.const_mul 2)).sub hRz.continuousAt
+  have hp : D =ᶠ[𝓝[≠] z] fun _ => 0 := meromorphicOrderAt_eq_top_iff.mp htop
+  have he : D z = 0 := tendsto_nhds_unique
+    (hDc.tendsto.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds) (tendsto_const_nhds.congr' hp.symm)
+  exact sub_eq_zero.mp he
+

+private theorem boundary_moment_limits {μ : Measure ℝ} {U σ c δ : ℝ}
+    (hU : 0 < U) (hσ : σ < 0) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hδ : 0 < δ)
+    (hi : ∀ x : ℝ, σ < x → Integrable (fun u : ℝ => Real.exp (-x * u)) μ)
+    {S H : ℂ → ℂ} (hS : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ S {z | σ < z.re})
+    (heq : ∀ z : ℂ, σ < z.re → laplace μ z =
+      laplace (density U (envelope σ c)) z - S z)
+    (hH : DifferentiableOn ℂ H (Metric.ball (σ : ℂ) δ))
+    (hHS : EqOn H S (D5.S3.Analytic.Laplace.EulerLocalContinuation.rightHalfDisk σ δ)) :
+    Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => ε ^ 2 * ∫ u, u * Real.exp (-(σ + ε) * u) ∂μ)
+      (𝓝[Ioi 0] 0) (𝓝 0) ∧
+    Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => ε ^ 2 * ∫ u, u ^ 2 * Real.exp (-(σ + ε) * u) ∂μ)
+      (𝓝[Ioi 0] 0) (𝓝 c) := by
+  let K := laplace (density U (envelope σ c))
+  have hK := envelope_analytic hU hσ hc
+  have hG1 : ∀ z : ℂ, σ < z.re → moment μ 1 z = -deriv K z + deriv S z := by
+    intro z hz
+    have he : laplace μ =ᶠ[𝓝 z] fun w => K w - S w := by
+      filter_upwards [(isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).mem_nhds hz]
+        with w hw using heq w hw
+    have hd := he.deriv_eq
+    change deriv (laplace μ) z = deriv (K - S) z at hd
+    have hs1 : deriv (K - S) z = deriv K z - deriv S z :=
+      deriv_sub (hK z hz).differentiableAt (hS z hz).differentiableAt
+    rw [laplace_deriv hi hz, hs1] at hd
+    linear_combination -hd
+  have hG2 : ∀ z : ℂ, σ < z.re → moment μ 2 z = deriv (deriv K) z - deriv (deriv S) z := by
+    intro z hz
+    have he : deriv (laplace μ) =ᶠ[𝓝 z] fun w => deriv K w - deriv S w := by
+      filter_upwards [(isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).mem_nhds hz] with w hw
+      rw [laplace_deriv hi hw, hG1 w hw]
+      ring
+    have hd := he.deriv_eq
+    change deriv (deriv (laplace μ)) z = deriv (deriv K - deriv S) z at hd
+    have hs2 : deriv (deriv K - deriv S) z = deriv (deriv K) z - deriv (deriv S) z :=

+  have hε : Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => (ε : ℂ)) (𝓝[Ioi 0] 0) (𝓝 (0 : ℂ)) :=

+  have hp : Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => (σ : ℂ) + (ε : ℂ)) (𝓝[Ioi 0] 0) (𝓝 (σ : ℂ)) := by

+  have hHa := (hH.analyticOnNhd Metric.isOpen_ball) (σ : ℂ) (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ)
+  have hSd : ∀ᶠ ε : ℝ in 𝓝[Ioi 0] 0,

+      deriv (deriv S) ((σ : ℂ) + (ε : ℂ)) = deriv (deriv H) ((σ : ℂ) + (ε : ℂ)) := by
+    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin,
+      mem_nhdsWithin_of_mem_nhds (Iio_mem_nhds hδ)] with ε hε0 hεδ
+    have hεp : 0 < ε := hε0

+      · simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hεp] using hεδ

+    have ho : IsOpen (D5.S3.Analytic.Laplace.EulerLocalContinuation.rightHalfDisk σ δ) :=

+      filter_upwards [ho.mem_nhds hz] with w hw using (hHS hw).symm

+  have hS1 : Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => deriv S ((σ : ℂ) + (ε : ℂ))) (𝓝[Ioi 0] 0)

+  have hS2 : Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => deriv (deriv S) ((σ : ℂ) + (ε : ℂ))) (𝓝[Ioi 0] 0)
+      (𝓝 (deriv (deriv H) (σ : ℂ))) :=
+    (hHa.deriv.deriv.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hp).congr' (hSd.mono fun _ h => h.2.symm)
+  have hS1zero : Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => (ε : ℂ) ^ 2 * deriv S ((σ : ℂ) + (ε : ℂ)))
+      (𝓝[Ioi 0] 0) (𝓝 (0 : ℂ)) := by simpa using (hε.pow 2).mul hS1
+  have hS2zero : Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => (ε : ℂ) ^ 2 * deriv (deriv S) ((σ : ℂ) + (ε : ℂ)))
+      (𝓝[Ioi 0] 0) (𝓝 (0 : ℂ)) := by simpa using (hε.pow 2).mul hS2
+  have he : Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => Complex.exp (-(ε : ℂ) * (U : ℂ)))
+      (𝓝[Ioi 0] 0) (𝓝 (1 : ℂ)) := by

+  have hK1zero : Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => (ε : ℂ) ^ 2 * deriv K ((σ : ℂ) + (ε : ℂ)))

+        Complex.exp (-(ε : ℂ) * (U : ℂ)) * (ε : ℂ))

+    apply hh0.congr'
+    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with ε hε0
+    have hεp : 0 < ε := hε0
+    have hn : (ε : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hεp.ne'
+    rw [show K = laplace (density U (envelope σ c)) from rfl,

+      simpa using hh

+    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with ε hε0
+    have hεp : 0 < ε := hε0
+    have hn : (ε : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hεp.ne'
+    rw [show K = laplace (density U (envelope σ c)) from rfl,

+    simp only [add_sub_cancel_left]

+    apply hh0.congr'
+    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with ε hε0
+    rw [hG1 _ (by simp only [add_re, ofReal_re]; change 0 < ε at hε0; linarith)]
+    ring
+  have hm2 : Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => (ε : ℂ) ^ 2 * moment μ 2 ((σ : ℂ) + (ε : ℂ)))
+      (𝓝[Ioi 0] 0) (𝓝 (c : ℂ)) := by
+    have hh0 : Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => (ε : ℂ) ^ 2 * deriv (deriv K) ((σ : ℂ) + (ε : ℂ)) -
+        (ε : ℂ) ^ 2 * deriv (deriv S) ((σ : ℂ) + (ε : ℂ)))
+        (𝓝[Ioi 0] 0) (𝓝 (c : ℂ)) := by simpa using hK2c.sub hS2zero
+    apply hh0.congr'
+    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with ε hε0
+    rw [hG2 _ (by simp only [add_re, ofReal_re]; change 0 < ε at hε0; linarith)]

+  · have hh := Complex.continuous_re.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hm1
+    simpa only [← Complex.ofReal_add, real_moment, pow_one, ← Complex.ofReal_pow,
+      ← Complex.ofReal_mul, ofReal_re, zero_re, Function.comp_def] using hh
+  · have hh := Complex.continuous_re.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hm2
+    simpa only [← Complex.ofReal_add, real_moment, ← Complex.ofReal_pow,

+private theorem norm_pole_coefficient_le {μ : Measure ℝ} {σ c : ℝ} {a b : ℂ}
+    (ha : a.re = σ) (hpos : ∀ᵐ u ∂μ, 0 ≤ u)
+    (hi : ∀ x : ℝ, σ < x → Integrable (fun u : ℝ => Real.exp (-x * u)) μ)
+    (hm1 : Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => ε ^ 2 * ∫ u, u * Real.exp (-(σ + ε) * u) ∂μ)
+      (𝓝[Ioi 0] 0) (𝓝 0))
+    (hm2 : Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => ε ^ 2 * ∫ u, u ^ 2 * Real.exp (-(σ + ε) * u) ∂μ)
+      (𝓝[Ioi 0] 0) (𝓝 c))
+    (hp : Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => (ε : ℂ) ^ 2 * euler (laplace μ) (a + (ε : ℂ)))
+      (𝓝[Ioi 0] 0) (𝓝 b)) : ‖b‖ ≤ ‖a‖ * c := by
+  have hε : Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => (ε : ℂ)) (𝓝[Ioi 0] 0) (𝓝 (0 : ℂ)) :=
+    Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt.tendsto.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
+  have hr : Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => ‖a + (ε : ℂ)‖ *
+      (ε ^ 2 * ∫ u, u ^ 2 * Real.exp (-(σ + ε) * u) ∂μ) +
+      2 * (ε ^ 2 * ∫ u, u * Real.exp (-(σ + ε) * u) ∂μ))
+      (𝓝[Ioi 0] 0) (𝓝 (‖a‖ * c)) := by
+    simpa using (((tendsto_const_nhds.add hε).norm.mul hm2).add (hm1.const_mul 2))
+  apply le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto hp.norm hr
+  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with ε hε0
+  have hεp : 0 < ε := hε0
+  have hz : σ < (a + (ε : ℂ)).re := by simp only [add_re, ofReal_re, ha]; linarith
+  have h1 := moment_norm_le hpos 1 (a + (ε : ℂ))
+  have h2 := moment_norm_le hpos 2 (a + (ε : ℂ))
+  simp only [add_re, ofReal_re, ha, pow_one] at h1 h2
+  rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hεp,
+    euler, laplace_deriv hi hz, laplace_second hi hz]
+  calc
+    ε ^ 2 * ‖(a + (ε : ℂ)) * moment μ 2 (a + (ε : ℂ)) +
+        2 * -moment μ 1 (a + (ε : ℂ))‖ ≤
+        ε ^ 2 * (‖a + (ε : ℂ)‖ * ‖moment μ 2 (a + (ε : ℂ))‖ +
+        2 * ‖moment μ 1 (a + (ε : ℂ))‖) := by
+      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (sq_nonneg _)
+      simpa only [norm_mul, norm_neg, norm_ofNat] using
+        norm_add_le ((a + (ε : ℂ)) * moment μ 2 (a + (ε : ℂ)))
+          (2 * -moment μ 1 (a + (ε : ℂ)))
+    _ ≤ ε ^ 2 * (‖a + (ε : ℂ)‖ * (∫ u, u ^ 2 * Real.exp (-(σ + ε) * u) ∂μ) +
+        2 * (∫ u, u * Real.exp (-(σ + ε) * u) ∂μ)) := by
+      gcongr
+    _ = _ := by ring

+/-- Every genuine zero in the open right half of the critical strip forces
+arbitrarily late positive peaks with the full critical exponent and exact
+multiplicity coefficient. -/
+theorem critical_theta_tail_peak {ρ : ℂ} (hβ : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < ρ.re)
+    (hβ1 : ρ.re < 1) (hzero : riemannZeta ρ = 0) :
+    let m := analyticOrderNatAt riemannZeta ρ
+    0 < m ∧ ρ.im ≠ 0 ∧
+      ∀ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c → c < (m : ℝ) / (‖ρ‖ * ‖ρ - 1‖) →
+        ∀ T : ℝ, ∃ u : ℝ, max T (Real.log 2) < u ∧
+          c < u * Real.exp ((1 - ρ.re) * u) * ActualThetaTailLaplace.f u := by
+  dsimp only
+  have hnonreal := zeta_zero_nonreal hβ hβ1 hzero
+  have hmult := (ThetaLaplaceContinuation.theta_laplace_continuation 0 le_rfl).2.2.2.2.2.2.2
+    ρ hβ hzero
+  refine ⟨hmult.2.2.1, hnonreal, ?_⟩
+  intro c hc hcA T
+  by_contra! hn
+  let σ := ρ.re - 1
+  let a := ρ - 1
+  let m := analyticOrderNatAt riemannZeta ρ
+  let α : ℂ := -(m : ℂ) / ρ
+  let U := max (max T (Real.log 2)) 1 + 1
+  have hσ : σ < 0 := by dsimp [σ]; linarith
+  have hσhalf : -(1 / 2 : ℝ) < σ := by dsimp [σ]; linarith
+  have hU0 : 0 < U := by dsimp [U]; linarith [le_max_right (max T (Real.log 2)) (1 : ℝ)]
+  have hU : ActualThetaTailLaplace.u₀ ≤ U := by
+    dsimp [U, ActualThetaTailLaplace.u₀]
+    linarith [le_max_left (max T (Real.log 2)) (1 : ℝ), le_max_right T (Real.log 2)]
+  have hbound : ∀ u : ℝ, U < u → ActualThetaTailLaplace.f u ≤ envelope σ c u := by
+    intro u hu
+    have hu0 : 0 < u := hU0.trans hu
+    have huT : max T (Real.log 2) < u := by
+      dsimp [U] at hu
+      linarith [le_max_left (max T (Real.log 2)) (1 : ℝ)]
+    have hh := hn u huT
+    have hep : 0 < u * Real.exp ((1 - ρ.re) * u) := mul_pos hu0 (Real.exp_pos _)
+    calc
+      ActualThetaTailLaplace.f u ≤ c / (u * Real.exp ((1 - ρ.re) * u)) := by
+        apply (le_div_iff₀ hep).mpr
+        nlinarith [hh]
+      _ = envelope σ c u := by
+        dsimp [envelope, σ]
+        rw [show (ρ.re - 1) * u = -((1 - ρ.re) * u) by ring, Real.exp_neg]
+        field_simp
+  let μ := density U (gap σ c)
+  let K := laplace (density U (envelope σ c))
+  let G := laplace μ
+  obtain ⟨hi, hfi, hL, hODE⟩ := comparison_halfplane hU hU0 hσ hσhalf hc hbound
+  have hK := envelope_analytic hU0 hσ hc
+  have heq : ∀ z : ℂ, σ < z.re → G z = K z - ActualThetaTailLaplace.L U z := by
+    intro z hz
+    exact gap_laplace_eq hU hU0 hσ hc hbound hz (hfi _ hz)
+  have hGeuler : ∀ z : ℂ, σ < z.re → AnalyticAt ℂ (forcing U) z →
+      euler G z = envelopeEuler U σ c z - forcing U z := by
+    intro z hz hR
+    have he : G =ᶠ[𝓝 z] fun w => K w - ActualThetaTailLaplace.L U w := by
+      filter_upwards [(isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).mem_nhds hz]
+        with w hw using heq w hw
+    rw [euler_congr he, euler_sub (hK z hz) (hL z hz),
+      envelope_euler hU0 hσ hc hz, hODE z hz hR]
+  have hRσ := forcing_real_analytic U hU0.le hσhalf
+  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrr⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hRσ.eventually_analyticAt
+  have hRball : DifferentiableOn ℂ (forcing U) (Metric.ball (σ : ℂ) r) :=
+    fun z hz => (hrr hz).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
+  have hFhalf : DifferentiableOn ℂ (ActualThetaTailLaplace.L U)
+      (D5.S3.Analytic.Laplace.EulerLocalContinuation.rightHalfDisk σ r) :=
+    hL.differentiableOn.mono (fun _ hz => hz.2)
+  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, _, H, hH, hHS⟩ :=
+    D5.S3.Analytic.Laplace.EulerLocalContinuation.exists_extension_of_ne_zero hσ.ne hr
+      hRball hFhalf (fun z hz => hODE z hz.2 (hrr hz.1))
+  obtain ⟨hm1, hm2⟩ := boundary_moment_limits hU0 hσ hc hδ hi hL heq hH hHS
+  obtain ⟨_, ha0, _, _, _, J, hJ, _, hLaurent, _, _⟩ :=
+    (ThetaLaplaceContinuation.theta_laplace_continuation U hU0.le).2.2.2.2.2.2.2 ρ hβ hzero
+  have hare : a.re = σ := by simp [a, σ]
+  have hPa : AnalyticAt ℂ (envelopeEuler U σ c) a := by
+    apply envelopeEuler_analytic
+    intro he
+    have hh := congrArg Complex.im he
+    simp only [a, sub_im, one_im, sub_zero, ofReal_im] at hh
+    exact hnonreal hh
+  let W : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => envelopeEuler U σ c z - (J z - deriv J z + boundary U z)
+  have hW : AnalyticAt ℂ W a := hPa.sub ((hJ.sub hJ.deriv).add (by unfold boundary; fun_prop))
+  have hlocal : ∀ᶠ z : ℂ in 𝓝 a,
+      z ≠ a → (fun z => -deriv (ThetaLaplaceContinuation.M U) z + ThetaLaplaceContinuation.M U z)
+        =ᶠ[𝓝 z] (fun z => α / (z - a) ^ 2 + α / (z - a) + J z - deriv J z) := by
+    have hh := eventually_nhds_nhdsWithin.mpr hLaurent
+    filter_upwards [hh] with z hz hza
+    exact hz.filter_mono (nhdsWithin_eq_nhds.mpr
+      (isClosed_singleton.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hza) |>.ge)
+  have hε : Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => (ε : ℂ)) (𝓝[Ioi 0] 0) (𝓝 (0 : ℂ)) :=
+    Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt.tendsto.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
+  have hp : Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => a + (ε : ℂ)) (𝓝[Ioi 0] 0) (𝓝 a) := by
+    simpa using tendsto_const_nhds.add hε
+  have hpNE : Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => a + (ε : ℂ)) (𝓝[Ioi 0] 0) (𝓝[≠] a) := by
+    apply tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr
+    refine ⟨hp, ?_⟩
+    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with ε hε0
+    have hεp : 0 < ε := hε0
+    simpa using Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hεp.ne'
+  have hlim : Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => (ε : ℂ) ^ 2 * euler G (a + (ε : ℂ)))
+      (𝓝[Ioi 0] 0) (𝓝 (-α)) := by
+    have hh : Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => -α - α * (ε : ℂ) +
+        (ε : ℂ) ^ 2 * W (a + (ε : ℂ))) (𝓝[Ioi 0] 0) (𝓝 (-α)) := by
+      simpa using (tendsto_const_nhds.sub (tendsto_const_nhds.mul hε)).add
+        ((hε.pow 2).mul (hW.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hp))
+    apply hh.congr'
+    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin, hp.eventually hlocal,
+      hp.eventually hJ.eventually_analyticAt, hpNE.eventually hLaurent]
+      with ε hε0 hl hJz hTz
+    have hεp : 0 < ε := hε0
+    have hn : (ε : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hεp.ne'
+    have hza : a + (ε : ℂ) ≠ a := by simpa using hn
+    have hd : a + (ε : ℂ) - a ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hza
+    have hTa : AnalyticAt ℂ
+        (fun z => -deriv (ThetaLaplaceContinuation.M U) z + ThetaLaplaceContinuation.M U z)
+        (a + (ε : ℂ)) := by
+      apply (((((analyticAt_const.div ((analyticAt_id.sub analyticAt_const).pow 2)
+          (pow_ne_zero 2 hd)).add (analyticAt_const.div
+          (analyticAt_id.sub analyticAt_const) hd)).add hJz).sub hJz.deriv)).congr
+      exact (hl hza).symm
+    have hR : AnalyticAt ℂ (forcing U) (a + (ε : ℂ)) :=
+      hTa.add (by unfold boundary; fun_prop)
+    rw [hGeuler _ (by simp only [add_re, ofReal_re, hare]; linarith) hR]
+    change _ = (ε : ℂ) ^ 2 *
+      (envelopeEuler U σ c (a + (ε : ℂ)) -
+        ((-deriv (ThetaLaplaceContinuation.M U) (a + (ε : ℂ)) +
+          ThetaLaplaceContinuation.M U (a + (ε : ℂ))) + boundary U (a + (ε : ℂ))))
+    change -deriv (ThetaLaplaceContinuation.M U) (a + (ε : ℂ)) +
+        ThetaLaplaceContinuation.M U (a + (ε : ℂ)) =
+        α / (a + (ε : ℂ) - a) ^ 2 + α / (a + (ε : ℂ) - a) +
+          J (a + (ε : ℂ)) - deriv J (a + (ε : ℂ)) at hTz
+    rw [hTz]
+    dsimp only [W]
+    simp only [add_sub_cancel_left]
+    field_simp
+    ring
+  have hnorm := norm_pole_coefficient_le hare (density_nonneg hU0.le (gap σ c)) hi hm1 hm2 hlim
+  have hρ0 : ρ ≠ 0 := Complex.ne_zero_of_re_pos (by linarith)
+  have hρnorm : 0 < ‖ρ‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hρ0
+  have hanorm : 0 < ‖a‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr ha0
+  have hcoef : (m : ℝ) / ‖ρ‖ ≤ ‖a‖ * c := by
+    simpa only [α, norm_neg, norm_div, Complex.norm_natCast] using hnorm
+  have hA : (m : ℝ) / (‖ρ‖ * ‖a‖) ≤ c := by
+    apply (div_le_iff₀ (mul_pos hρnorm hanorm)).mpr
+    have hh := (div_le_iff₀ hρnorm).mp hcoef
+    nlinarith
+  exact (not_le_of_gt hcA) hA
+
+#print axioms critical_theta_tail_peak
+
+end D5.S3.Weil.Mertens.CriticalThetaTailPeak

+**推论 33.1（固定阈值的共享逆平方阶）。** 对固定 $t\in(0,1)$ 和 $0<|\delta|<d$，上述最小元存在，且
+
+$$
+\begin{aligned}
+r\delta^2\le c_t&\ \Longrightarrow\ e_r(t,\delta)\ge E_r(P_{t,t+\delta})\ge V(t)/2,\\
+r\delta^2>H_t&\ \Longrightarrow\ e_r(t,\delta)<V(t)/2.
+\end{aligned}
+\tag{33.2}
+$$
+
+若 $r_*(t,\delta)$ 为（18.5）的最小平方风险越阈半径，则
+
+$$
+\boxed{\quad
+\left\lfloor\frac{c_t}{\delta^2}\right\rfloor+1
+\le r_*(t,\delta)
+\le\widehat r_*(t,\delta)
+\le\left\lfloor\frac{H_t}{\delta^2}\right\rfloor+1.
+\quad}
+\tag{33.3}
+$$
+
+特别地 $\widehat r_*\delta^2>c_t$ 且 $\widehat r_*\delta^2\le H_t+\delta^2$。因此在固定 $t$、固定半方差阈值下，$|\delta|^{-2}$ 阶既是任何有限外部平方损失估计器的必要阶，也由同一参数盲二值规则达到。
+
+**证明。** 必要方向直接复用定理 18.2：该定理的参数是同一 $p=t,q=t+\delta$，其 $\delta_t=d$，风险和字段均相同。把其（18.4）与（32.8）串联，即得（33.2）的第一行，包含 $r\delta^2=c_t$。无需重作路径相对熵比较。
+
+若 $r\delta^2>H_t$，定理 29.2 给出
+
+$$
+e_r(t,\delta)\le B_t e^{-a_t r\delta^2}
+<B_t e^{-a_t H_t}=V(t)/2.
+$$
+
+取 $R=\lfloor H_t/\delta^2\rfloor+1$，则 $R\delta^2>H_t$，所以定义（33.1）的集合非空。整数良序给出 $\widehat r_*$，并有 $\widehat r_*\le R$。在 $\widehat r_*$ 处由 $E_r\le e_r$ 得 $r_*\le\widehat r_*$，再由定理 18.2 得最左界。严格下界与 $\lfloor x\rfloor+1\le x+1$ 分别给出两个乘积界。该证明不要求 $e_r$ 随 $r$ 单调；（33.2）的充分条件保证每个满足它的半径，而非仅某个被选半径。常数没有尖锐性断言，也未给出 $r_*\delta^2$ 或 $\widehat r_*\delta^2$ 的极限值。$\square$
+

+**Theorem 6.1 (reinstatement into the earned same-source consumers).**
+At the completed handoff of Theorem 3.2 the actual record (ACR.4) satisfies
+GPO Definition 34.1 with its separately surviving binding and grants.
+On the original domain $n\ge n_0$, it therefore determines exactly
+
+$$
+ S_n,\quad\partial S_n,\quad
+ \mathcal T_n^{\rm birth}=
+ \bigl(n;(t_j,p_j,z_j)_{1\le j\le B_n}\bigr),\quad X_n,
+ \tag{ACR.21}
+$$
+
+and the complete finite-request behavior of that same source. The
+GPO Theorem 34.2 round trips agree on these data images. Without expanding
+the whole tree, GPO Definition 39.3 can answer each supplied physical
+word's label, presence and terminal status with the request-local work
+of GPO Proposition 39.5. With GPO Theorem 34.3's continued real binding,
+rights, completed-call synchronization, progress, retention and backing,
+these consumers remain correct through every finite actual serial
+continuation, including real paid Reads and completed updates.
+
+Proof. The old retained prefix and complete seeded descriptor are
+unchanged. Theorem 3.2 has reinstated precisely the two numerical fields
+missing from GPO (GPO.84). The stationary interval includes installation,
+so they name the actual handoff cut. All other premises of GPO Definition
+34.1 are Assumption 1.2's actual surviving relations, not inferred
+consequences of numerical equality. The maturity bound is exactly that
+of GPO Theorem 34.2, including its separate zero-order case. Apply that
+theorem to obtain (ACR.21) and its commuting round trips.
+
+GPO Theorem 39.4 identifies the physical evaluator on these same $L,n$
+with actual readout at every finite word, including absent words. GPO
+Theorem 34.3 then advances $n,B_n$ only on real completed updates and
+commits new local data before exposing another callable cut. Its invariant
+and continuation premises yield the assertion by induction on actual
+calls. Reconstructing a behavioral phase as in Theorem 3.2 is sufficient;
+it requires no inverse of a singular transition and no identification
+of a private register implementation. An expanded tree or full event
+trace in (ACR.21) still costs its explicit output and backing.
+
+The projections in (ACR.21) omit arbitrary stationary observer actions:
+inserting a stationary Read or local calculation before erasure changes
+the observer journal while leaving $L,n,B_n$ and every birth event
+unchanged. Thus these inverses do not recover arbitrary lost journals,
+all material memory bytes, lost capabilities or physical durations.
+$\square$

+**Lemma 12.1 (conditional variance-weighted block contraction).** Use the setup of Lemma 5.1: $U$ is binary, $Z,Z'$ are finite, $V$ is conditioning data, $W$ ranges over a finite family of words, and the matrices $B_w$ satisfy (5.1) and $\sum_wB_w\mathbf1=\mathbf1$. For almost every $V=v$, put
+
+$$
+p_v(w)=\mathbb P(W=w\mid V=v),\qquad
+\Delta_w(v)=\mathcal D(U;Z\mid V=v,W=w)\quad(p_v(w)>0),
+\qquad
+\Delta(v)=\sum_{w:p_v(w)>0} p_v(w)\Delta_w(v).
+\tag{12.1}
+$$
+
+Assume $0\le\delta(B_w)\le1$ for every $w$ with $p_v(w)>0$, and that, for some $0\le\kappa<1$,
+
+$$
+\sum_{w:p_v(w)>0} p_v(w)\,\delta(B_w)\,\Delta_w(v)
+\le \kappa\,\Delta(v)
+\tag{12.2}
+$$
+
+for almost every $v$ with $\Delta(v)>0$. All sums involving $\Delta_w(v)$ range over positive-probability words; zero-probability conditional versions are omitted. No diameter or conditional variance is assigned to a null word; in particular, the zero matrix remains excluded as in Definition 3.4. Fibers with $\Delta(v)=0$ are vacuous: every $\Delta_w(v)$ with positive $p_v(w)$ is then zero. Under these assumptions,
+
+$$
+\mathcal D(U;Z'\mid V,W)
+\le
+\kappa\bigl[\mathcal D(U;Z\mid V)-\mathcal D(U;W\mid V)\bigr]
+\le
+\kappa\,\mathcal D(U;Z\mid V).
+\tag{12.3}
+$$
+
+The hypothesis (12.2) is fiberwise in the posterior variances. It is not a stationary word average.
+
+**Proof.** Fix a $V=v$ fiber and a word $w$ of positive conditional probability. The conditional kernel in (5.4) has row diameter $\delta(B_w)$, so the conditional form of Lemma 4.3, applied on this $(v,w)$-fiber, gives
+
+$$
+\mathcal D(U;Z'\mid V=v,W=w)
+\le \delta(B_w)\Delta_w(v).
+$$
+
+Multiply by $p_v(w)$, sum over $w$, and use (12.2). Integrating over $v$ gives
+
+$$
+\mathcal D(U;Z'\mid V,W)\le\kappa\,\mathcal D(U;Z\mid V,W).
+$$
+
+The variance identity (5.5) rewrites the last factor as
+$\mathcal D(U;Z\mid V)-\mathcal D(U;W\mid V)$, and dropping the nonnegative term $\mathcal D(U;W\mid V)$ gives (12.3). No comparison of the reweighted priors in (5.3) is used. $\square$
+

+2. $\lvert Q_{3,2,1}(z_1+1,z_2+1)\rvert\le1$.

+\tag{4.5}
+$$
+
+For any length-$s$ contiguous segment of the stationary process, classify its label by the nearest $\rho_\ell$ to its empirical mean, with any fixed tie rule. If $s\Delta\ge4$, its error probability under any component, and under their actual mixture, is at most
+
+$$
+2\exp(-s\Delta^2/32).
+\tag{4.6}
+$$
+
+Proof. Under one component with parameter $a$ and mean $\rho=a/(1+a)$, put $Y_j=X_j-\rho$ and
+
+$$
+Z_j=Y_j+aY_{j-1}=X_j-a(1-X_{j-1}),\qquad 1\le j\le s.
+$$
+
+The Markov transition rule gives $\mathbb E[Z_j\mid X_0,\ldots,X_{j-1}]=0$, and $|Z_j|\le1$. For any conditional mean-zero $Z\in[-1,1]$, convexity of the exponential gives
+
+$$
+\mathbb E[e^{tZ}\mid\mathcal H]\le\frac{e^t+e^{-t}}2
+=\cosh t\le e^{t^2/2}.
+\tag{4.7}
+$$
+

+
+$$
+\Pr\left(\left|\sum_{j=1}^sZ_j\right|\ge u\right)
+\le2\exp(-u^2/(2s)).
+\tag{4.8}
+$$
+
+Moreover,
+
+$$
+\sum_{j=1}^sZ_j=(1+a)\sum_{j=1}^sY_j+a(Y_0-Y_s),\qquad
+|a(Y_0-Y_s)|\le1.
+\tag{4.9}
+$$
+
+An empirical-mean deviation of at least $\Delta/2$ therefore forces $|\sum Z_j|\ge s\Delta/2-1\ge s\Delta/4$ when $s\Delta\ge4$. Substitution into (4.8) gives (4.6). Misclassification implies such a deviation, since distinct component means are separated by at least $\Delta$. The preceding bit $X_0$ is used only in this proof, not by the classifier. Stationarity gives the same bound for any translated segment, including one in the past. Averaging over the one actual label preserves the bound. This is the elementary bounded-martingale exponential method; see the mathematical citation [Azuma] below. $\square$

+**Proposition 13.3 (failure of the post-word weighted condition at the right initial cut).** For every $m\ge1$, take the right cut $j=0$ of Theorem 12.3 with the identity quotient:
+
+$$
+V=V_0^R=X_{-\infty:-1},\qquad Z=H_1,\qquad W=X_{1:m},\qquad U=X_0.
+$$
+
+For almost every $v$ on $\{X_{-1}=0,S_0=s\}$, the post-word residual of (12.1) is
+
+$$
+\Delta(v)=\sum_{w:p_v(w)>0}p_v(w)\Delta_w(v)
+=\begin{cases}1/6,&s=0,\\1/5,&s=1.\end{cases}
+\tag{13.6}
+$$
+
+Any good set whose positive-probability words have global diameter at most $\rho<1$ has no positive-probability word here. Consequently its bad-word variance divided by the exact denominator $\Delta(v)$ is one. Thus (12.7) fails for every $\eta<1$ on these positive-measure sets, and the global-diameter condition (12.2) fails for every $\kappa<1$.
+
+**Proof.** The whole past identifies $s$ and the previous bit. On the stated event, $U$ is Bernoulli with parameter $a_s$ and $Z=(1-s,U)$ determines $U$. In particular,
+
+$$
+\mathcal D(U;Z\mid V=v)=a_s(1-a_s).
+$$
+
+For the word $0^m$, put $T_{s,m}=\prod_{i=2}^{m}t_{s+i\bmod2}$, with the empty product equal to one. Its two center masses are
+
+$$
+\mathbb P(U=1,W=0^m\mid V=v)=a_sT_{s,m},\qquad
+\mathbb P(U=0,W=0^m\mid V=v)=\frac12T_{s,m}.
+\tag{13.7}
+$$
+
+Both are positive. Hence $\Delta_{0^m}(v)=q_s(1-q_s)>0$, where $q_s=a_s/(1/2+a_s)$. More generally, $X_1=1$ forces $U=0$, while, conditional on $X_1=0$ and the known phase, observations $X_2,\ldots,X_m$ give no further information about $U$. Since $Z$ determines $U$, summing the posterior variances therefore gives
+
+$$
+\Delta(v)=\mathbb P(X_1=0\mid V=v)q_s(1-q_s)
+=(a_s+1/2)\frac{a_s(1/2)}{(a_s+1/2)^2}
+=\frac{a_s/2}{a_s+1/2}.
+$$
+
+This is (13.6), with no dependence on $m\ge1$. Proposition 13.2 says that every positive-probability word has global forward diameter one. Thus the entire positive residual is carried by bad words, and both weighted left-hand sides equal $\Delta(v)$. The phase/previous-zero events have probabilities $8/22$ and $9/22$, respectively, so failure is not confined to null conditioning data.

+The denominator is essential. Dividing the same residual by the variance *before* observing $W$ instead gives
+
+$$
+\frac{\Delta(v)}{\mathcal D(U;Z\mid V=v)}
+=\begin{cases}8/9,&s=0,\\9/10,&s=1.\end{cases}
+\tag{13.8}
+$$
+

+### 17.4. A common saturated domain for the original versions
+
+Fix any original Borel exterior version $q_0=\mathbb E_{P_\theta}[X_0\mid\mathcal E_0]$, and let $q_i=q_0\circ T^i$, as in [Attainment, Definition 1.3][ClockAttainment]. Almost-sure agreement with (17.14) alone would not justify evaluating that agreement at arbitrary modified configurations. The following domination supplies the required bridge within this fixed interior law.
+
+Set
+
+$$
+\alpha=\min_s b_s>0,\qquad \beta=\max_s b_s<1.
+\tag{17.15}
+$$
+
+Let $S_i^0$ force bit $i$ to zero. Let $S_i^1$ insert one at $i$ on $F_i$, and be the identity on $F_i^c$. Both are total legal Borel maps. Disintegrating over $\mathcal E_i$, with $q_i^*$ as the conditional probability of one, gives for every Borel set $B$
+
+$$
+\begin{aligned}
+P_\theta((S_i^0)^{-1}B)
+ &\le\frac{P_\theta(B\cap\{X_i=0\})}{1-\beta},\\
+P_\theta((S_i^1)^{-1}B)
+ &\le\frac{P_\theta(B\cap F_i\cap\{X_i=1\})}{\alpha}
+       +P_\theta(B\cap F_i^c).
+\end{aligned}
+\tag{17.16}
+$$
+
+For example, writing $y$ for the exterior and $0y$ for its zero completion, the left side of the first inequality is $\int\mathbf1_B(0y)\,d\mu_i(y)$, whereas its numerator is $\int\mathbf1_B(0y)(1-q_i^*(y))\,d\mu_i(y)$. The bound follows from $1-q_i^*\ge1-\beta$ almost surely. On the free fiber the analogous conditional mass of $1y$ is at least $\alpha$; off that fiber $S_i^1$ is the identity. This proves the second inequality. Thus both maps are nonsingular for this particular $P_\theta$. No attained band or nonsingularity premise for arbitrary stationary laws was assumed.
+
+Let $\mathcal G$ be the countable monoid generated by every $S_i^0,S_i^1$, both shifts and the identity. Stationarity and (17.16) make every element nonsingular. If
+
+$$
+E=\Gamma\cap\bigcap_{i\in\mathbb Z}\{q_i=q_i^*\},\qquad
+\Omega_{\rm ag}=\bigcap_{g\in\mathcal G}g^{-1}E,
+\tag{17.17}
+$$
+
+then $\Omega_{\rm ag}$ is Borel and conull. Closure under composition gives $g\Omega_{\rm ag}\subseteq\Omega_{\rm ag}$ for every generator; using both shifts gives shift invariance. Every legal finite modification can be performed by first zeroing a containing interval and then inserting the desired nonadjacent ones. Compatibility with the unchanged exterior makes each insertion legal. Hence $\Omega_{\rm ag}$ is saturated under every legal finite modification, and every original $q_i$ agrees with (17.5) at all points of this domain. This is the countable-saturation method of [Exterior, Theorem 3.1][ClockExterior], with domination supplied directly by (17.15)--(17.16). The domain is for fixed versions and a fixed parameter, not for every conceivable version or every parameter simultaneously.

+**Theorem 8.3 (An entire quartic exceeding every normalized monomial).** For every real $0<d\le\tfrac12$, define
+
+$$
+e=\frac{d^2}{6},\qquad N=\sqrt{1+4e^2},\qquad
+G_d(z)=\frac{z^3/6+e(z^2/2-z^4/12)}{N}.
+$$
+
+Then $G_d$ has real coefficients and degree exactly four, belongs to $\mathscr E_2(\mathbb D)$ with $\|G_d''\|_{\mathbb D}=1$, and satisfies
+
+$$
+L_d(G_d)=d\sqrt{1+\frac{d^4}{9}}>d
+=\sup_{t\in\mathbb Z,\ t\ge2}|L_d(m_t)|.
+$$
+
+Stance: repo-derived.
+
+**Proof.** Since $e>0$ and $N>0$, the coefficient of $z^4$ is $-e/(12N)\ne0$. Differentiating twice gives
+
+$$
+G_d''(z)=\frac{z+e(1-z^2)}N.
+$$
+
+For $z=e^{i\theta}$ on the unit circle,
+
+$$
+z+e(1-z^2)=z\bigl(1-2ie\sin\theta\bigr),\qquad
+|z+e(1-z^2)|^2=1+4e^2\sin^2\theta\le N^2,
+$$
+
+with equality at $z=i$ and $z=-i$. The classical maximum modulus principle, applied to this polynomial on the closed unit disk, gives $\|G_d''\|_{\mathbb D}=1$. Thus the polynomial is an admissible entire input to the exact class of Definition 8.1.
+
+To calculate its error, set $a=1-d$ and $b=\sqrt3\,d$. The two-variable identity $h_3(a+ib,a-ib)=4a(a^2-b^2)$ gives
+
+$$
+h_3(w_d,\overline{w_d})
+=4(1-d)(1-2d-2d^2)=4-12d+8d^3,
+$$
+
+and hence, by the monomial error formula in Proposition 8.2,
+
+$$
+L_d(m_4)=d-\frac23d^3,\qquad
+L_d(m_2-m_4)=\frac23d^3=4de.
+$$
+
+The functional $L_d$ is complex-linear and $G_d=[m_3+e(m_2-m_4)]/N$. Using Proposition 8.2 at degrees two and three therefore gives
+
+$$
+L_d(G_d)=\frac{d+4de^2}{N}=dN
+=d\sqrt{1+\frac{d^4}{9}}>d.
+$$
+
+The final comparison uses $d>0$ and Proposition 8.2 for every degree $t\ge2$. $\square$

+The complementary diminished Sombor index of a graph is $\sum_{uv\in E}\sqrt{d_u^2+d_v^2}/\max(d_u,d_v)$. +**定理 42.1（有限时域连续性与严格精度条件）。** 固定 $0<t<1$ 和 $0<\epsilon\le1/4$。考虑同一嵌套外部字段上的一个确定规则，停止半径为 $T\in\mathbb Z_{\ge1}\cup\{\infty\}$，有限停止时输出 $U_T\in\{0,1\}$，满足
+
+$$
+\{T\le r\}\in\mathcal F_r,\qquad
+\{T=r,U_T=a\}\in\mathcal F_r
+\quad(r\ge1,\ a\in\{0,1\}).
+\tag{42.1}
+$$
+
+在对角线与下面的所有参数处，使用完全相同的有限词映射。取任一非零序列 $\delta_n\to0$，使 $t+\delta_n\in(0,1)$。若
+
+$$
+P_{t,t+\delta_n}(T<\infty,U_T\ne X_0)\le\epsilon
+\qquad\text{对每个 }n,
+\tag{42.2}
+$$
+
+则
+
+$$
+\boxed{\quad
+P_{t,t}(T=\infty,F)
+\ge\frac{D_t}{1+t}-\frac{\epsilon}{m_t}.
+\quad}
+\tag{42.3}
+$$
+
+这里 $D_t,m_t$ 如（41.1）。右端严格为正的条件恰为
+
+$$
+\boxed{\quad
+\epsilon<\frac{\min(t,(1-t)^2)}{1+t}.
+\quad}
+\tag{42.4}
+$$
+
+在此严格条件下，满足（42.2）的同一规则不能还在该对角线律下几乎处处停止。任一穿孔邻域上一致的终止误差控制都蕴含（42.2）；本定理不要求非对角线上几乎处处停止。
+
+**证明。** 固定一个确定整数 $r\ge1$。由（42.1）及有限词规则共享，
+
+$$
+E_r^{\rm err}=\{T\le r,U_T\ne X_0\}
+$$
+
+是在有限字母表 $(X_0,Y_r)$ 上由同一个子集定义的事件。其概率是有限个原平稳柱概率 $\lambda M_w\mathbf1$ 的和。原矩阵条目及 $\lambda$ 在开方形上连续，因此此事件概率也连续。这正是第 6 节及第 29–34 节使用的原有限观察对应；中心仍只作为错误事件的目标，未加入规则输入。

+由（42.2），对每个 $n$ 都有 $P_{t,t+\delta_n}(E_r^{\rm err})\le\epsilon$。先只在这个固定时域取参数极限，得到 $P_{t,t}(E_r^{\rm err})\le\epsilon$。然后令整数 $r$ 增加，事件递增到全部有限停止错误事件，概率的从下连续性给出
+
+$$
+P_{t,t}(T<\infty,U_T\ne X_0)\le\epsilon.
+\tag{42.5}
+$$
+
+参数极限只在固定有限时域内使用，没有与无界停止操作交换。
+
+令 $A_a=\{T<\infty,U_T=a\}$，$a=0,1$。每个 $A_a$ 是 $\{T=r,U_T=a\}$ 的可数并，故为完整外部字段 $\mathcal E_0$ 可测；两个事件不交。用引理 41.1 的完整外部后验，$F$ 上的错误概率为
+
+$$
+\begin{aligned}
+P_{t,t}(T<\infty,U_T\ne X_0,F)
+&=\mathbb E[\mathbf1_{A_0\cap F}X_0]
+  +\mathbb E[\mathbf1_{A_1\cap F}(1-X_0)]\\
+&=s_tP(A_0\cap F)+(1-s_t)P(A_1\cap F)\\

+\end{aligned}
+\tag{42.6}

+**Proposition 7.1 (two mature cuts after total erasure require live input).**
+For every $d\ge0$ there are two admissible inputs of §1 with identical
+retained data and common entry resources but different numerical target
+and physical support. No source-blind source-free local calculation
+can recover the numerical cut on both, even with unlimited finite work
+and growing backing.
+
+Proof. Choose the identically zero member of $\mathscr R_d$. For
+$d>0$, execute the actual acquisition of GPO §33 once and retain its
+fixed acquired zero prefix and selected authentic seeded zero-law
+descriptor. For $d=0$ use its zero-order descriptor. Consider that same
+origin orbit at cuts $u$ and $u+1$, with any $u\ge n_0$, after making
+the stipulated complete erasure. Choose equal accessible entry control
+and backing, and retain the same root binding and valid rights. Both
+cuts satisfy the original maturity domain. The fixed earlier acquisition
+data are identical. Neither a copied phase nor an allocation/counter
+channel survives. The stationary interval is available on each input.
+
+Their targets differ: $u\ne u+1$, and
+$B_{u+1}-B_u=F_u>0$. Their physical supports differ as well, since
+update $u+1$ splits at least one beta leaf and adds persistent children;
+indeed its count increases from $2F_{u+1}-1$ to $2F_{u+2}-1$.
+A local program receiving no live reply has identical state transitions
+on the two equal entry memories, hence identical output if it terminates.
+It cannot output both cuts. For zero-error randomness couple the coin
+tape; the two output distributions are identical, while the required
+exact outputs differ. Growing local work cannot split this information
+fiber. $\square$

+假设 $n\ge1$。某一侧内区间没有锚，意味着该侧长度 $s$ 的区间全为零。由（22.1）和
+$$
+\left\lfloor\frac{\lfloor r/2\rfloor}{2}\right\rfloor=\left\lfloor\frac r4\right\rfloor

+$$

+=e^{-2\vartheta\lfloor r/4\rfloor}
+\le e^{2\vartheta}e^{-\vartheta r/2}.
+\tag{24.1}
+$$

+$$

+$$

+\le e^{-\vartheta r/2}M^{2n}

+$$

+$$

+## 26. 指数风险界、地板效应与小半径
+
+当 $n\ge1$ 时，前两节覆盖了所有可能的解码错误（缺锚、计数失败或集中失败），故
+$$
+P_{t,q}(f_r(Y_r)\ne X_0)
+\le2e^{2\vartheta}e^{-\vartheta r/2}
+ +2e^{-\vartheta r/4}
+ +4e^{-n\delta^2/8}.
+\tag{26.1}
+$$
+该事件只依赖可见过程，故在联合律 $J$ 和可见律 $P$ 下概率相同。因为 $n\ge\beta r-1$ 且 $\delta^2<d^2$，
+$$
+4e^{-n\delta^2/8}
+\le4e^{d^2/8}e^{-\beta r\delta^2/8}.
+$$
+由 $\gamma\le\vartheta/(4d^2)$ 和 $\gamma\le\beta/8$，右侧三项分别不超过
+$$
+2e^{2\vartheta}e^{-\gamma r\delta^2},\qquad
+2e^{-\gamma r\delta^2},\qquad
+4e^{d^2/8}e^{-\gamma r\delta^2}.
+$$
+
+若 $n=0$，则 $\beta r<1$，解码错误概率至多为一；又有 $r\delta^2<d^2/\beta$，所以
+$$
+1\le e^{\gamma d^2/\beta}e^{-\gamma r\delta^2}.
+\tag{26.2}
+$$
+合并（26.1）和（26.2）得到第二个不等式（20.2），并覆盖 $r=1$、空内区间、所有地板效应以及任意小的正 $r\delta^2$。

+P_{t,q}(f_r(Y_r)\ne X_0)
+&=\mathbb E_{P_{t,q}}[(X_0-f_r)^2]\\
+&=E_r(P_{t,q})+\mathbb E_{P_{t,q}}[(\eta_r-f_r)^2]

+$$

+0&\frac12&0&\frac12\\
+0&0&0&\frac12\\
+0&0&\frac12&0
+\end{pmatrix},
+\qquad
+M_1=
+\begin{pmatrix}
+0&0&0&0\\
+0&0&0&0\\
+0&\frac12&0&0\\
+\frac18&\frac38&0&0
+\end{pmatrix},
+\qquad
+\lambda=\left(\frac1{13},\frac{11}{26},\frac5{26},\frac4{13}\right).
+\tag{11.3}
+$$
+
+Then $A=M_0+M_1$ is stochastic, $\lambda A=\lambda$, $M_1^2=0$, and $A$ is irreducible; hence (11.3) is a legal positive stationary $\Theta_4$ witness. Let $\pi=\{0,1\}\mid\{2,3\}$. Its forward quotient has
+
+$$
+\bar\lambda=\left(\frac12,\frac12\right),
+\qquad
+\bar M_0=\frac12\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\0&1\end{pmatrix},
+\qquad
+\bar M_1=\frac12\begin{pmatrix}0&0\\1&0\end{pmatrix},
+\tag{11.4}
+$$
+
+and the canonical reverse in (11.1) is
+
+$$
+R_0=\frac12\begin{pmatrix}1&0\\1&1\end{pmatrix},
+\qquad
+R_1=\frac12\begin{pmatrix}0&1\\0&0\end{pmatrix}.
+\tag{11.5}

+The feasible-row diameters of $\bar M_0,R_0$ are $1/2$, and those of $\bar M_1,R_1$ are $0$. Thus (3.7) holds with $m_+=m_-=1$ and $\rho_+=\rho_-=1/2$, and Proposition 11.1 transfers (6.1)--(6.3) to this representation's visible law.

+\begin{pmatrix}

+0&\frac12&0&\frac12\\

+\qquad

+**Proposition 8.4 (Minimum polynomial degree of a violation).** For every real $0<d\le\tfrac12$ and every polynomial $P\in\mathbb C[z]$ of degree at most three with $\|P''\|_{\mathbb D}\le1$,
+
+$$
+|L_d(P)|\le d.
+$$
+
+The bound is attained by $m_2$ and $m_3$. Consequently the minimum degree of a polynomial in $\mathscr E_2(\mathbb D)$ with $|L_d(P)|>d$ is exactly four, for each grid $W_d$. Stance: repo-derived.
+
+**Proof.** Write $P''(z)=A+Bz$ with $A,B\in\mathbb C$. Then $P=A m_2+B m_3+R$ for some affine polynomial $R$. Interpolation reproduces $R$, so $L_d(R)=0$, and Proposition 8.2 yields $L_d(P)=d(A+B)$. For complex $A,B$,
+
+$$
+\|A+Bz\|_{\mathbb D}=|A|+|B|.
+$$
+
+The upper bound is the triangle inequality. If $A$ and $B$ are both nonzero, equality is attained at $z=(A/|A|)(\overline B/|B|)$, which has modulus one and makes $Bz$ a nonnegative real multiple of $A$. If either coefficient is zero, equality is immediate. Therefore
+
+$$
+|L_d(P)|=d|A+B|\le d(|A|+|B|)
+=d\|P''\|_{\mathbb D}\le d.
+$$
+
+Theorem 8.3 provides a violating polynomial of degree four, and the preceding bound excludes every lower degree, including all complex coefficient choices. $\square$

+**Lemma 3.2 (Floor for a universal vertex).** Let $\ell\ge1$, $n\ge3$ and $G\in\mathcal G(n,\ell)$ have a universal vertex. Then $E(G)\ge c_\ell$, and
+
+$$
+c_\ell\ge\frac{2\ell}{(\ell+1)^2+1}.
+$$
+
+Stance: suspected-novel (see §6).
+
+**Proof.** Let $h$ be a universal vertex. The $n-1$ edges at $h$ each have $\varphi\ge1$. The remaining $m-(n-1)=\ell$ edges avoid $h$. For $u\ne h$ let $e_u$ be the number of these $\ell$ edges at $u$; then $d_u=1+e_u$ and $e_u\le\ell$. If $uv$ is one of the $\ell$ edges avoiding $h$, then $e_u,e_v\ge1$, so $2\le d_u,d_v\le\ell+1$ and $r=\min(d_u,d_v)/\max(d_u,d_v)\ge2/(\ell+1)$. Since $\sqrt{1+r^2}$ increases in $r$, each such edge has $\varphi(d_u,d_v)\ge\sqrt{(\ell+1)^2+4}/(\ell+1)$. Summing, $\Phi(G)\ge(n-1)+\ell\sqrt{(\ell+1)^2+4}/(\ell+1)=m+c_\ell$.
+
+For the lower bound on $c_\ell$, put $x=4/(\ell+1)^2$. Rationalising gives $\sqrt{1+x}-1=x/(\sqrt{1+x}+1)$, and $\sqrt{1+x}\le1+x/2$ (square both sides), so $\sqrt{1+x}-1\ge x/(2+x/2)=2x/(4+x)$. Hence $c_\ell=\ell(\sqrt{1+x}-1)\ge\ell\cdot2x/(4+x)=2\ell/((\ell+1)^2+1)$. ∎

+**Proposition 4.3 (entry information and necessary same-input traffic).**
+If an apparent window $[A,H]$ includes cuts below $n_0$, its effective
+candidate set is $[\max(A,n_0),H]$, if nonempty; (ACR.16)–(ACR.17)
+use that interval and its actual cardinality. They give no lower bound
+based on excluded cuts.
+
+In Definition 4.1, on every run at an interior age $A<n<H$, any exact
+deterministic controller must submit both a first-birth-$n$ literal
+and a first-birth-$(n+1)$ literal. Consequently on that very input
+
+$$
+ W(n)\ge\lceil n/2\rceil+\lceil(n+1)/2\rceil=n+1,
+ \qquad M(n)\ge\lceil(n+1)/2\rceil.
+ \tag{ACR.18}
+$$
+
+The same conclusion holds on every $n>n_0$ for an exact controller on
+the whole unbounded domain $[n_0,\infty)$. At its lower endpoint it
+must at least submit a first-birth-$(n_0+1)$ literal.
+
+Proof. The maturity promise excludes precisely the lower cuts specified
+in the first assertion; source-independent common entry supplies no
+further age information. For (ACR.18), compare the run at $n$ first
+with that at $n-1$. Until a different reply they have identical control.
+The sole threshold separating these ages is $n$, so their first
+difference requires a first-birth-$n$ query on the run at $n$.
+Comparison instead with $n+1$ forces a first-birth-$(n+1)$ query on
+that same run. These are distinct query occurrences. Proposition 2.2
+bounds their separate lengths, giving the sum and maximum. The
+unbounded domain has both neighbours of every $n>n_0$, and its endpoint
+has the upper neighbour. This is a per-input necessary bill, not a
+pointwise simultaneous optimality claim for one universal controller.
+$\square$

+response (ACR.7), or is the constant-present empty word. Its replies
+have two values. Every deterministic controller terminating on these finitely many

A positive integer $p\le |z|$ is a period of a nonempty finite word $z=z_0\cdots z_{|z|-1}$ if $z_j=z_{j+p}$ for $0\le j<|z|-p$. Write $\operatorname{per}(z)$ for its least period. +**定理 42.1（有限时域连续性与严格精度条件）。** 固定 $0<t<1$ 和 $0<\epsilon\le1/4$。考虑同一嵌套外部字段上的一个确定规则，停止半径为 $T\in\mathbb Z_{\ge1}\cup\{\infty\}$，有限停止时输出 $U_T\in\{0,1\}$，满足
+
+$$
+\{T\le r\}\in\mathcal F_r,\qquad
+\{T=r,U_T=a\}\in\mathcal F_r
+\quad(r\ge1,\ a\in\{0,1\}).
+\tag{42.1}
+$$
+
+在对角线与下面的所有参数处，使用完全相同的有限词映射。取任一非零序列 $\delta_n\to0$，使 $t+\delta_n\in(0,1)$。若
+
+$$
+P_{t,t+\delta_n}(T<\infty,U_T\ne X_0)\le\epsilon
+\qquad\text{对每个 }n,
+\tag{42.2}
+$$
+
+则
+
+$$
+\boxed{\quad
+P_{t,t}(T=\infty,F)
+\ge\frac{D_t}{1+t}-\frac{\epsilon}{m_t}.
+\quad}
+\tag{42.3}
+$$
+
+这里 $D_t,m_t$ 如（41.1）。右端严格为正的条件恰为
+
+$$
+\boxed{\quad
+\epsilon<\frac{\min(t,(1-t)^2)}{1+t}.
+\quad}
+\tag{42.4}
+$$
+
+在此严格条件下，满足（42.2）的同一规则不能还在该对角线律下几乎处处停止。任一穿孔邻域上一致的终止误差控制都蕴含（42.2）；本定理不要求非对角线上几乎处处停止。
+
+**证明。** 固定一个确定整数 $r\ge1$。由（42.1）及有限词规则共享，
+
+$$
+E_r^{\rm err}=\{T\le r,U_T\ne X_0\}
+$$
+
+是在有限字母表 $(X_0,Y_r)$ 上由同一个子集定义的事件。其概率是有限个原平稳柱概率 $\lambda M_w\mathbf1$ 的和。原矩阵条目及 $\lambda$ 在开方形上连续，因此此事件概率也连续。这正是第 6 节及第 29–34 节使用的原有限观察对应；中心仍只作为错误事件的目标，未加入规则输入。
+
+由（42.2），对每个 $n$ 都有 $P_{t,t+\delta_n}(E_r^{\rm err})\le\epsilon$。先只在这个固定时域取参数极限，得到 $P_{t,t}(E_r^{\rm err})\le\epsilon$。然后令整数 $r$ 增加，事件递增到全部有限停止错误事件，概率的从下连续性给出
+
+$$
+P_{t,t}(T<\infty,U_T\ne X_0)\le\epsilon.
+\tag{42.5}
+$$
+
+参数极限只在固定有限时域内使用，没有与无界停止操作交换。
+
+令 $A_a=\{T<\infty,U_T=a\}$，$a=0,1$。每个 $A_a$ 是 $\{T=r,U_T=a\}$ 的可数并，故为完整外部字段 $\mathcal E_0$ 可测；两个事件不交。用引理 41.1 的完整外部后验，$F$ 上的错误概率为
+
+$$
+\begin{aligned}
+P_{t,t}(T<\infty,U_T\ne X_0,F)
+&=\mathbb E[\mathbf1_{A_0\cap F}X_0]
+  +\mathbb E[\mathbf1_{A_1\cap F}(1-X_0)]\\
+&=s_tP(A_0\cap F)+(1-s_t)P(A_1\cap F)\\
+&\ge m_tP(T<\infty,F).
+\end{aligned}
+\tag{42.6}
+$$
+
+这些期望均在 $P_{t,t}$ 下。左侧不超过（42.5），所以 $P(T<\infty,F)\le\epsilon/m_t$；从 $P(F)=D_t/(1+t)$ 中减去即为（42.3）。因
+
+$$
+m_t\frac{D_t}{1+t}
+=\frac{\min(t,(1-t)^2)}{1+t},
+\tag{42.7}
+$$
+
+（42.3）的右端严格为正当且仅当（42.4）。在等号或反向范围，这个下界可能为零或负数，不提供正的普适不终止保证；这不声称该精度条件是所有可能障碍的必要条件。$\square$

The necessary band supplied by [Universal, Theorem 3.1][U] does not answer these questions. First-order conditional balances are not the pathwise property in Definition 6.1. +p_{j,v}^d(w)\,\Delta_{j,w}^d(v)
+\le \eta_d\,\Delta_j^d(v)
+\tag{12.7}
+$$
+
+holds for almost every $v$. Here $p_{j,v}^d(w)$, $\Delta_{j,w}^d(v)$, and $\Delta_j^d(v)$ are the quantities in (12.1) formed from $V_j^d,Z_j^d,W_j^d$.
+
+Then, for every $j\ge0$,
+
+$$
+e_L^{P_C}(j)\le\frac14\kappa_-^{\lfloor j/m_-\rfloor},
+\qquad
+e_R^{P_C}(j)\le\frac14\kappa_+^{\lfloor j/m_+\rfloor}.
+\tag{12.8}
+$$
+
+Consequently, for every $r\ge0$,
+
+$$
+A_{P_C}(r)\le\frac12\left[
+\frac{m_-\kappa_-^{\lfloor r/m_-\rfloor/2}}{1-\sqrt{\kappa_-}}
++
+\frac{m_+\kappa_+^{\lfloor r/m_+\rfloor/2}}{1-\sqrt{\kappa_+}}
+\right],
+\tag{12.9}
+$$
+
+and
+
+$$
+\tau_{P_C}(r)\le\frac14\left[
+\frac{m_-\kappa_-^{\lfloor r/m_-\rfloor}}{1-\kappa_-}
++
+\frac{m_+\kappa_+^{\lfloor r/m_+\rfloor}}{1-\kappa_+}
+\right].
+\tag{12.10}
+$$
+
+If every positive stationary component satisfies these directional conditions, the finite-mixture conclusions of Theorem 7.1 apply with the component-specific constants.

+**Proof.** Work on the quotient producer of Proposition 11.1, whose joint $(Q,X)$ law is (11.2). Apply Lemma 3.3 to its identity quotient and canonical reverse (11.1); no reverse lumpability of the original hidden representation is assumed. This supplies (5.1) at each left cut with $B_w=R_w$ and at each right cut with $B_w=\bar M_w$. Corollary 12.2 and (12.7) give the one-block recursions
+
+$$
+\mathcal D(U;Z_{j+m_-}^L\mid V_j^L,W_j^L)
+\le\kappa_-\mathcal D(U;Z_j^L\mid V_j^L),
+$$
+
+and
+
+$$
+\mathcal D(U;Z_{j+m_+}^R\mid V_j^R,W_j^R)
+\le\kappa_+\mathcal D(U;Z_j^R\mid V_j^R).
+$$
+
+The Jensen step in the proof of Theorem 6.1 transfers these quotient-state variances to the original output erasure errors. Starting from the $1/4$ variance bound at the initial cut, iterate complete blocks; a remainder of length smaller than $m_d$ has coefficient at most one. This proves (12.8). The geometric tail sums are exactly the estimates used for (6.2) and (6.3), with $\rho_\pm$ replaced by $\kappa_\pm$. No variance proof is added beyond Lemma 12.1, and no stationary word-average condition replaces the cutwise requirement (12.7). $\square$

+\kappa_r=\frac{\log\Lambda}{\log\beta},

+and, for each eigenvalue $\lambda$ of $M$, use the normalization
+
+$$
+v_\lambda=
+\bigl(\lambda^{2r-1}(\lambda-2),
+ \lambda^{2r-2}(\lambda-2),\ldots,\lambda-2,1\bigr)^T.

+\rho=\frac{|h v_\beta|}{H}.
